name: phpmyadmin
title: phpMyAdmin
description: Web interface for administering MySQL and MariaDB databases.
notes: This installation allows access to any database hosts.

env.name: CONTAINER_NAME
env.label: Container name
env.description: Container name, separate from the Portainer stack name.

env.name: PHPMYADMIN_PORT
env.label: Host port
env.description: Host port mapped to phpMyAdmin's HTTP port 80.

env.name: DATABASE_NETWORK
env.label: Network (optional)
env.description: Name of an existing network shared with your database container. Leave blank to use the built-in bridge network.
